nora: Initiating a slim RC cut for model-service v2.3.1-rc-slim. Targets: telemetry key additions + tiny attention-kernel microfix. Change window 2026-03-22 09:00-10:00 PST. Need QA + Security + Oncall ack and a candidate pin.

deploy-bot: artifact built: rsvc-2.3.1-rc-slim-20260322 (sha: b7c9e2). CI: unit \u2705 integ \u2705 smoke pending. suggested pins: candidate=pin_slim_900 fallback=pin_stable_400.

ash: Kicking off minimal canary (1% traffic) with smoke: `./deploy/smoke --ver rsvc-2.3.1-rc-slim --canary 1`

ash: smoke quick pass: p95 ~160ms, error rate 0.1%. saw small mem bump on canary-0, below threshold.

lucas: Oncall here. KV-warm not required but we'll warm 4 nodes as precaution: `scripts/kv_warm.sh --nodes 4`. Ramp plan: 1% x15m -> 10% x15m -> 100% x30m. Abort if 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 5m or p95 > 1.8x baseline.

nora: Release notes drafted: "telemetry: new rollout tags; runtime: attention kernel micro-optimizations; infra: no config surface change." PR: https://redwood.atl/p/notes/rc-slim

ops-bot: promo scheduled at 2026-03-22T09:10:00-08:00. rollout ticket: https://redwood.atl/rollouts/RC-20260322-SLIM001

ash: QA will run the golden eval after the 1% hold. Holding criteria: regen mismatch > 2% or new flakes > baseline.

lucas: Rollback runbook snippet for docs: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/model-service --to-revision=REV && curl -s -X POST https://ops-api/revert -d '{"pin":"pin_stable_400"}'`

nora: Setting candidate pin now. @deploy-bot please apply pin_slim_900 and stage fallback pin_stable_400.

deploy-bot: pins applied \u2014 candidate: pin_slim_900, fallback: pin_stable_400. Artifact and pins linked to rollout ticket. Reaction: :white_check_mark:

tai: Security quick review complete, no new scopes. Note: rotate ephemeral creds post-promo. security-bot: quick-scan OK, no findings.

nora: Go/no-go in T-5. Any holds?

ash: QA still in the 1% hold, no holds so far.

lucas: Oncall gives +1.

nora: Launching promo now. I'll post back after the 1% and 10% checks. Thanks all. :shipit:
